reviews.review: A profound masterpiece on the power of persistence. It beautifully illustrates that when you truly want something, the entire universe conspires to help you achieve it.
The most practical guide to behavior change I’ve ever read. It strips away the fluff and focuses on the tiny, 1% improvements that lead to massive long-term results.
A hauntingly beautiful exploration of class, obsession, and the elusive nature of the American Dream. The prose is as sharp and shimmering as it was a century ago.
A brilliant, albeit dense, breakdown of the cognitive biases that govern our lives. It’s essential reading for anyone who wants to understand why we make the choices we do.
An absolute titan of world-building. It blends politics, religion, and ecology into a complex narrative that feels more relevant to our modern climate every single day.
This isn't just about spreadsheets; it’s about the psychology behind our relationship with wealth. It offers a refreshingly human take on a traditionally dry subject.
